scope: P01 reproducible foundation and current P02 financial-core verification

jobs.name: Build, financial core, database and Compose smoke

junitCore.note: JUnit adapter executes the same Java case bodies as the standalone run and is not an additional 120 unique cases.

postgresFinancialIntegration.boundary: real PostgreSQL committed transactions through independent connections

secretScan.limitation: High-signal literal pattern scan, not a complete security assessment.

findingsResolvedDuringMilestone.finding: PostgreSQL rejected an unqualified accounts.status predicate because execute_command also declared a local status variable.
findingsResolvedDuringMilestone.fix: Additive Flyway V5 guarded function-definition repair; migration history and V2 checksum preserved.

findingsResolvedDuringMilestone.finding: A transient connection reset during JVM startup escaped the bounded readiness poll.
findingsResolvedDuringMilestone.fix: Treat connection-level startup errors as transient until the readiness deadline and retain hidden service logs.

limitations: This is not proof of complete G01-G16 release readiness.

Authentication, product REST APIs, RabbitMQ business processing, React UI, complete defect/fault campaigns, security/accessibility/performance suites, migration/restore proof and video remain incomplete.
No public full-stack deployment or release tag exists.
